RANK: CURV-RESID-CONTRAST | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 show the frozen 4-token chain loses gold prefixes between depths 2 and 4 (0.829 to 0.161 to 0.085) while successor-geometry variants that move codes or points land at 0.055 (successor_geodesic 0.0550, tangent_successor_residual 0.0550) against 0.0621 for the content-only Euclidean control, and this is the only proposal that leaves the item point and the codebook untouched and deforms just the residual-assignment metric from level 1 on (level 0 sits at the origin), spending the behaviour contrast that E9/E11 observe (cohort sharing 0.9291 vs 0.8871 negative, same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs 0.067 permuted null) exactly where the survival curve still has headroom.
RANK: CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ | position=2 | reason=it is built on the one behavioural quantity the bundle measures with a large OBSERVED spread (E5: successor entropy/top-1 mass 0.4375 in bin 1 vs 0.0543 in bin 5, Spearman -0.973) and injects it as a bounded conformal factor (g in [0.607,1.649]) inside the Lorentz assignment while keeping the item point and the codebook update fixed, the same content-preserving profile as the 0.0621/0.0623 euclid and l1_only controls that beat every successor-geometry variant in E6, with a full 8-step equation set and both switches; it ranks below #1 only because the signal is scalar concentration rather than the successor-vs-null contrast direction and it also perturbs level 0, where E6 depth-1 survival is already 1.000, and its realistic failure is a documented g to 1 wash-out at baseline rather than a gain.
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ | position=3 | reason=the most complete and most tightly coupled specification (L=4 matching the T1-T4 protocol, PT-based recursion, exact baseline at u=0, pole radius 1 with Poincare 0.762 below the saturation point, 6.3 MB buffer, under 1 percent cost), but it displaces the item point to a behaviour pole and projects the encoder orthogonal to u_hat_i, deleting content along the behaviour direction and moving level 0, which E6 shows is already saturated (gold prefix alive at depth 1 is 1.000 for every arm) and places it in the same point-moving family that produced the 0.055 successor_geodesic/tangent_successor_residual results rather than the 0.062 content-only result.
RANK: BCGR-LORENTZ | position=4 | reason=it targets the deep levels where E7 puts almost all residual difficulty (l1_br T4 NLL 9.03 vs 1.23 for the Euclidean control) and keeps the content point and the codebook, but the displacement is alpha_i times the codeword's own hyperbolic radius, so it cannot act on the near-origin codewords that levels 1-2 use (self-admitted no-op) and its strength is tied to the radial coordinate the evidence treats as uninformative, while alpha_i (forward/backward asymmetry) is not among the behavioural quantities measured in E5/E9/E11 and u_i is an unnormalised successor centroid rather than the matched-null contrast linked to recall.
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ__ideation_4 | position=5 | reason=its core novelty claim that item-specific gyration is a curvature effect with no Euclidean analogue is directly contradicted by E6, where the Euclidean control l1_br_euclid (0.0621, T4 NLL 1.23) beats the hyperbolic l1_br chain (0.0467, T4 NLL 9.03); the per-level Mobius frame shift is a constant-radius isometry tanh(rho), set once from the first forward pass, applied identically to every item, which ignores the five-bin, five-fold successor-predictability spread measured in E5 and risks artanh saturation at the boundary, and its operating equations are deferred to an unseen SPEC EQUATIONS block.
